paper.title: ConAlign: Conditional Alignment Framework for Balancing Biased and Unbiased Recommendation

local_changes: Reads data/raw instead of the repository datasets folder; rebuilt rows are byte-identical
Returns metrics/history and saves the checkpoint under checkpoints/conalign instead of the script folder
Optional --smoke-users subset and epoch overrides for smoke runs only
Since 2026-10-30 KuaiRand defaults to the paper window (kuairand_window='paper'): only logs 2022-04-22..05-08, train 04-22..05-05; kuairand_window='source' keeps the released loader byte-for-byte
paper_source_differences: Paper text (Sec. 4.1): KuaiRand logs April 22 to May 8, train first two weeks, validation day 15, test last two days. Source utils/load_kuairand.py builds train dates as 20220408 + i for i < 28, i.e. 20220408..20220430 then 20220431..20220435 (not real dates): May 1-5 never enter training although the docstring says 28 days to May 5. Validation 05-06 and test 05-07..08 agree
Paper describes KuaiRand-Pure as 1,000 users and 7,388 videos; the released Pure logs for April 22 to May 8 have 27,285 users and 7,583 videos
Paper reports UAUC/NDCG@5 without naming which source NDCG; artifacts keep every source metric name
